book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Atenda lihengo munng'unda ghwa misabibu
“Ghubhutwa ghwa kunane ghungulihwana na mundu ywakabheghite na nng'unda ghwa misabibu, ywene kakibhuka malabhila putiputi kuabhika atendalihengo mu nng'unda ghwake.
Kakilingana nabho kuapegha ligwala limu lya madini gha fesa kwa linjubha, mbole, kakiayegha ku nng'unda ghwake ghwa misabibu.
Payihikite musaa ndatu malabhila, kakiabhona bhandu bhangi bhaabheghite ng'obhe na lihengo lya kutenda, ayima mu ligulio.
Kakiaghombela, ‘Nng'ende mukatende lihengo munng'unda ghwangu ghwa misabibu, na nenga ndabhapegha kiibhanoghwa.’
Basi, bhakighenda. Aywo nkola nng'unda kakibhuka kangi payihikite saa sita na bhubho saa tisa kakitenda ubhwabhu habhu.
Hata payihikite saa kumi na yimu makimuhi, kakibhuka kangi, kakiabhona bhandu bhangi bhaayima pala paligulio. Basi, kakiakonya, ‘Kiyaha niki muyima apa leghi leghi tipi kyanga lihengo?’
Bhakinnyanga, ‘Kiyaha kakibhegha ng'obhe mundu ywakatupeghite lihengo lya kutenda.’ Naywo kakiaghombela, ‘Nng'ende mukatende lihengo mu nng'unda ghwangu ghwa misabibu.’ ”

“Payihikite makimuhi, yula nkola nng'unda ghwa misabibu kakiaghombela nnyimiha ywake, ‘Ghubhakeme atendalihengo na ghubhahombe lihombo lyahabhe, ghutandile kwa bhala bhaninganite nabho kuuhiko na mbole kwa bhala bhaaninganite nabho kalongohi.’
Basi, atenda lihengo bhaakemitwe mu saa kumi na yimu, bhakikingama kila yumu ligwala yimu lya madini gha fesa.
Habhu, bhala bha kalongohi paahikite bhakihwacha kukita bhaahombwa kyanalumu, peni kila yumu kakihombwa bhula bhula ligwala limu lya madini gha fesa.
Paahombitwe kala ligwala lya madini gha fesa, bhakinhyongolekela yula nkola nng'unda,
paalongela, ‘abha bhandu bhaahikite kuuhiko bhatenda lihengo kwa lilaa limu ghweka, bhuli ghututendela tela na bhombe kunu twenga tulimbilila lihengo linakutopo, na leghi leghi tipi muluchubha?’ ”
“Yula nkola nng'unda kakinnyanga yumoo ywabhe, ‘Ghanja, nughupugha ng'obhe kilibhi. Bhuli, tukilingana ng'obhe nikuhombe lihombo lya ligwala limu kwa linjubha limu?
Ghutole lihmbo lyako, ghughende ukaya. Nungupala kunhomba ayu ywa kuuhiko handa panughupeghite ghwenga.
Bhuli, nenga nungunoghwa ng'obhe kutenda kila kinukipala muutopelo ghwangu namwene? Bhuli, ghungubhona tama kiyaha nenga ndo mundu ywa maha?’ ”
Yesu kakiyomola kwa kulongela, “Ubhwabhu abhu ywa uhiko katabhegha ywa kalongohi na ywa kalongohi katabhegha ywa uhiko.”
Yesu kangulongela kangi mala ya ndatu yakya kiho na kuhyuka kwake

Yesu papamu na ahundwa bhake atangalo bhakibhegha bhangughenda ku Yelusalemu, pakabheghite munjila, kakiatola bhala ahundwa bhake kumi na abhili, kakighenda nabho pambwegha, na kuyobhela nabho ghweka chabhe, kakiaghombela,
“Nnyihwe. Tungughenda ku Yelusalemu, na akwo Mwana ywa Mundu kaayeghwa mumabhoko kwa mandundame akulu na ahunda bha Malaghilo, na akwo bhatantosa kakomwe,
mbole, bhatannyegha kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi ahotole kunnyuyuha na kuntuta hinjupunjupu na kummamba mulupingika, peni linjubha lya ndatu katahyuhwa.”
Mama kangupala bhana bhake bhabheghe akulu
Apwo mama ywabhe bhana bha Sebedayo kakinhikila Yesu papamu na bhana bhake, kakichutamila mayughwa mu ulongolo ghwake na kunnyupa kilibhi.

Yesu kakinnkonya, “Ghungupala niki?” Aywo mama kaking'ombela, “Ghulaghe, kukita yumu ywa abha bhana bhangu abhili, yumu katame mu mbande yako ya nnilo na yungi mu mbande yako ya ngiya ku Ghubhutwa ghwako.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Mwenga mungukimanya ng'obhe kila kimukiyupa. Bhuli, manguhotola kunyweghela nnobho ghumbala kunyweghela nenga?” Bhakinnyanga, “Tunguhotola.”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nnobho ghwangu ghwa kimbamanda mutaghunywela, peni kutama mbande yangu ya nnilo ebu ya kungiya, ali lyanenga kata kuapegha. Tate ywangu kalamula kala ndo ghani kaatama ku nnilo ebu ku ngiya ya nenga.”
Bhala ahundwa bhangi mbinda mabhoko yimu paaghayihwite agho, bhakiakalalila abho alongo abhili.

Habhu, Yesu kakiakema bhoha papamu, na kakiaghombela, “Mungumanya kukita atabhala bha nnima aghui bhanguatabhala bhandu kwa makakala, na hilongohi bhabhe bhanguatumikiha bhaabheghite mu utabhala ghwabhe.
Peni kwa mwenga yikotoke kubhegha habhu, ngati ywakapala kubhegha nkulu mu mwenga kangunoghwa kabheghe ndumintumi ywa bhoha,
na kila ywakapala kubhegha ghwa kalongohi mu mwenga kangunoghwa kabheghe mmandwa ywenu.
Handa bhula Mwana ywa Mundu kakihika ng'obhe kutumikilwa, ngati kuatumikkila na kuuhobhegha ubhumi ghwake kwa kuatenda bhandu atangalo ahotole kulopoka.”
Yesu kangualamiha bhangalola abhili
Yesu na ahundwa bhake paabheghite bhangubhuka ku kitami kya ku Yeliko, lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukintughila.
Basi, kukibhegha na bhangalola abhili atama pambwegha ya njila. Pabhayihwite kukita Yesu kangupita apwo, bhakiyobha kyobho paghalongela, “Bambo, Mwana ghwa Daudi, ghutubhonele luhungu.”
Lula lumati lwa bhandu lukialakalila na kualongela atame jii. Peni bhombe bhakichweha kuyobha kyobho, “Bambo, Mwana ywa Daudi, chonde ghutubhonele luhungu.”
Yesu kakiyima na kakiakema, kakiakonya “Mungupala nuatendele niki?”
Bhakinnyanga, “Bambo tungupala tuhotole kubhona.”
Yesu kakiabhonela luhungu, kakiabyala meho ghabhe, kamu bhakihotola kubhona, nabho bhakintughila.
